description: This file declares the EnvVariableParser class responsible for parsing environment variables related to logging configuration in the Rialto project. It includes methods to retrieve logging levels, and check if console or file logging is enabled, along with private configuration methods and internal state variables.

classes.name: EnvVariableParser
classes.description: Class responsible for parsing environment variables related to logging configuration, managing debug levels, and logging output settings.
